{{Quote|We Duloks have been troubled by insect bites lately, and we were wondering if you could spare&hellip;|[[Umwak]] begs Morag for a potion of her bug bite cure|<ref name="The Cries of the Trees">{{Ewoks|The Cries of the Trees}}</ref>}}
'''Bug-bite Cure''' was a potion prepared by the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] witch [[Morag]] that kept irritating bugs of the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] away from sentient creatures such as the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]]. The Dulok [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] [[Umwak]] was forced to grovel to Morag and promise favors in return for the substance. Morag would reluctantly part with the bug-bite cure only after the Duloks would agree to do Morag favors in return.
